cases.name: honest
cases.says: the receipt for the commit under review, signed by the operator, tests passed
cases.head: tested

cases.name: another signer
cases.says: a genuine receipt for the same commit, signed by a key that is not the operator's
cases.head: tested

cases.name: edited result
cases.says: the honest receipt with one exit code changed inside it
cases.head: tested

cases.name: failing tests
cases.says: a genuine receipt, correctly signed, for a run whose tests failed
cases.head: broken

cases.name: passing report beside a failing run
cases.says: the failing run's genuine receipt with a passing JUnit file put next to it
cases.head: broken

cases.name: wrong commit
cases.says: the honest receipt presented for a later commit it never tested
cases.head: later

cases.name: wrong repository
cases.says: the honest receipt presented for another repository
cases.head: tested

cases.name: every test skipped
cases.says: a genuine, correctly signed receipt for a run in which every step exited 0 and the returned report lists only skipped tests
cases.head: skipped

cases.name: timed out
cases.says: a genuine, correctly signed receipt for a run the 30-second limit ended, its report cut off mid-write
cases.head: hangs
